title: ATSR Supplementary Materials and Reproducibility Archive
description:
Code, frozen protocol, prompts, specifications, raw model outputs, ground-truth and rating workbooks, de-identified ratings, and the analysis script and outputs for the expanded evaluation of the AI-Assisted Test Scope Recommender (ATSR) reported in AI-Assisted Test Scope Recommendation for Manual QA: A Framework and Evaluation (Arbaz Surti; manuscript under revision at Scientific Reports, 2026).

The evaluation compares three prompt conditions (naive, generic structured QA, ATSR) across three model families (GPT-4o 2024-11-20, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Llama 3.3 70B) with three runs each on 18 frozen specifications (486 generation cells), rated blind by the author and two independent QA practitioners on a five-dimension rubric after a three-person consensus ground truth. Every statistic in the manuscript is reproduced byte-for-byte by research/analyze_operative_ratings.py from the archived files; see README.md for instructions. Version 1.0.0 (the original single-model evaluation) is retained under original-evaluation/.

Participant identities, consent records, and the identity-to-code mapping are not included.
